description: This class defines Swagger API response schemas for the Loan COB Catch-Up API in the Fineract project. It includes response models for the oldest COB processed loan details and catch-up running status.

classes.name: LoanCOBCatchUpApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger schemas for the Loan COB Catch-Up API responses.

classes.name: GetOldestCOBProcessedLoanResponse
classes.description: Represents the response containing the oldest COB processed loan IDs and dates.

classes.name: IsCatchUpRunningResponse
classes.description: Represents the response indicating if the catch-up process is running and the processing date.
